stage: W1 path-level planning inventory, not an executable test allowlist or completed gate

policy.baseline: v1.23.48 semantic product runtime; current D and historical evidence retained; approved A/B later; later C not migrated
policy.layout: Four historical root HTML/CSS files mapped to current src/app and src/popup; audit all path consumers before restore; selected three JS files are known candidates, not proof of complete path closure.
policy.tests: Preserve every test/fixture path and pinned blob. Classifications are initial ownership/disposition candidates, not permission to disable tests. Before W3/W4 activation review actual assertions and all invocation owners, split mixed C/product tests, retain behavior/safety negatives and immutable Gold; update KAR167 coverage-closure contract explicitly without claiming excluded tests PASS. Historical npm invocations form baseline characterization reference. Current D gate and old path references require concrete adaptation.
policy.noRelease: No main merge, live data, updater activation, real account actions, release or full build.
